key.name: format
key.description: Template for the copied text. Placeholders: {artist}, {title}, {album}. An empty field is dropped together with the separator next to it.

key.name: show-link-button
key.description: Add a second button to the media notification that copies the track's URL, for example a Spotify or YouTube link.

key.name: copy-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that copies the currently playing track without opening the notification list. Empty disables it.
